root_causes.description: The CS000B status check bound release_authorized=false to one literal Portuguese substring instead of accepting unambiguous equivalent negative statements.
The historical CS000A validation workflow remained selectable on unrelated future pull requests and applied its old ChangeSet-specific allowlist.

corrections: Preserve the failed CS000B candidate, plan, verifier, documentation bytes and run evidence.
Do not rerun the failed CS000B source SHA.
Use a new CS000C verifier with semantic negative-release fixtures and explicit negative controls.
Retire automatic pull_request selection for superseded CS000A and failed CS000B workflows; preserve their bodies from permissions onward.
Validate the new correction on a new exact candidate SHA.
